visual.name: roadmapTimeline
visual.description: Turn your milestones, releases and project phases into a winding roadmap that's easy to follow. Each event is a numbered pin on a styled path, with a callout card for its title and description. Choose from wavy, arc, zig-zag, straight or random curvy paths, add road markings or a 3D perspective effect, and bring the story to life with a left-to-right reveal animation. Fully themeable, supports cross-filtering, drill through, the right-click context menu and tooltips, and respects high contrast and reduced motion settings.
